description: Get a whole tournament in ONE call: event facts, roster, stored bracket (plus any unconfirmed bracket preview), schedule, call screens, recent activity, pending actions and permissions. Built for AI consoles (MCP Apps) so one call can render the full event state instead of six separate reads. Read-only; contact details and the audit trail are included only with a valid manage_code, and never appear without one.

code.description: Optional manage_code — unlocks the audit trail and organizer permissions

name: get_event_context
